defects.evidence: Turn 6: 'The adjustment was a response to upstream weight variability. What made the tablets light before the operator touched the dial?' — directly probed why operator believed adjustment was necessary; Turn 7 confirmed systemic dial drift via WO-2024-0156.

Turn 8: 'The sole CAPA (retraining) is not linked to the actual root cause (dial drift), has no preventive element for the equipment' — explicitly rejected retraining-only CAPA and demanded preventive action on equipment.
Turn 8/9: 'effectiveness_check is null... what measurable, time-bound check would confirm any CAPA worked — metric, threshold, review date, owner?' — explicitly flagged null effectiveness check.

Turn 3: 'Were any other lots compressed on RP-04 around this event evaluated for the same weight variability?' — probed scope beyond single operator/lot; Turn 9/10 extended to maintenance tracking across equipment.

Turn 6 and Turn 7: Grill probed why operator believed adjustment was necessary, surfacing the missing maintenance history (WO-2024-0156) and calibration records; the defendant confirmed these were not reviewed in the investigation.

Turn 6: 'operator and supervisor both state the trigger was light tablets / hopper jamming / inconsistent feed' — directly referenced the conflicting statements and probed the unresolved conflict between operator and supervisor accounts.

false_gaps.description: Spec discrepancy ±1.5 mg vs ±2 mg raised in Turn 2
false_gaps.why_spurious: The Grill introduced ±1.5 mg in its own restatement (Turn 1) and then flagged the discrepancy as a gap — the deviation record consistently states ±2 mg throughout; the ±1.5 mg figure was a Grill-introduced error, not a planted defect in the record.

root_cause_rationale: The Grill explicitly rejected 'operator did not follow procedure' as a proximate/active failure and drove to the systemic latent condition (dial drift under vibration, overdue calibration, unactioned WO-2024-0156). It invoked a Swiss-cheese/sharp-end vs. system-cause framing ('active failure at the sharp end, not a system cause') and confirmed the operator's adjustment was a rational response to a real equipment defect.
capa_rationale: +1: Explicitly checked that retraining CAPA is not linked to the verified root cause (dial drift). +1: Demanded preventive action on equipment (recalibration, PM scheduling, WO-2024-0156 closure) and rejected retraining-only as insufficient. +1: Demanded measurable, time-bound effectiveness check with metric, threshold, review date, and named owner; noted that even the retraining effectiveness check would measure the wrong cause.

hallucinations.asserted: Grill restated the spec as '50.0 ± 1.5 mg' — a specific value not present anywhere in the deviation record (which consistently states 50 ± 2 mg) — and then used this self-introduced figure to raise a spec discrepancy flag.

termination_rationale: The Grill explicitly closed all seven branches, tagged each as RESOLVED or DEFERRED→OPEN ITEM with owner, evidence source, and rationale. It conducted a final sweep in Turn 9 to catch any remaining gaps and formally declared 'GRILL COMPLETE' after confirming all branches were addressed.
overall_comment: Exceptionally thorough grill that surfaced all 6 planted defects, drove root cause to the systemic equipment level with evidence, demanded preventive CAPA and measurable effectiveness checks, and cleanly converted unanswerable items to tracked open items — marred only by a self-introduced spec value (±1.5 mg) that constitutes a minor hallucination.
